privileged_info_for_vlm: The OpenBCI Cyton accelerometer typically streams at a fixed rate of 25Hz by default. While the task asks to 'configure' it, the VLM should verify that the GUI reflects '25Hz' in the Hardware Settings. Note that in some versions of the software, this may be a fixed display value rather than a toggleable option, but the agent must still navigate to the correct panel and capture the screenshot at the specified path: /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/accel_config.png.
